entities.summary: Michael Brodsky is an Israeli diplomat. He was nominated as the next Israeli Ambassador to Ukraine on November 26, 2020. From 2015 to 2018, Brodsky served as the Israeli ambassador to the Republic of Kazakhstan. He was succeeded by Liat Wexelman in September, 2018.
